storage.empty.poolsText: Pick two or more free disks and NoCapOS sets up a mirror or RAIDZ for you.
storage.empty.freeDisks: No free disks right now. Plug in a new one, or free one up first.
storage.empty.partitions: No partitions — this disk is a blank canvas.
storage.confirm.exportBody: NoCapOS lets go of the pool so you can move its disks to another computer. Nothing gets deleted; import it again whenever.
storage.confirm.deleteSnapBody: {name} gets deleted. Your current files stay as they are.
storage.toast.imported: Pool {name} is back in the chat
storage.toast.snapTaken: Snapshot taken — you’ve got a save point
storage.toast.rolledBack: {name} is back to how it was
storage.toast.replaceStarted: Replacement started — ZFS is copying data to the new disk
storage.toast.testTakes: It takes {eta}; the disk stays usable and you’ll get pinged with the result.
storage.toast.testHours: It can take hours; the disk stays usable and you’ll get pinged with the result.
